scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @einfachvermieter/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @einfachvermieter/desktop
scripts.setup: npm run rebuild:native && npm run freeze-pdf-assets
scripts.db:wipe: rm -f data/einfachvermieter.db data/einfachvermieter.db-shm data/einfachvermieter.db-wal && rm -rf data/uploads data/statements && npm run db:push
scripts.db:reset:minimal: npm run db:wipe && npm run db:seed:minimal
scripts.db:reset:demo: npm run db:wipe && npm run db:seed:demo
scripts.db:reset:local: npm run db:wipe && npm run db:seed:local
